47
48    private var streakProgress: Double {
49        let done = [waterDone, sleepDone, habitsVM.profile.customHabitCompletedToday].filter { $0 }.count
50        return Double(done) / 3.0
51    }
52    private var waterDone: Bool { habitsVM.profile.dailyWaterML >= habitsVM.profile.waterMLTarget * 0.8 }
53    private var sleepDone: Bool { habitsVM.profile.sleepHours >= habitsVM.profile.sleepHoursTarget * 0.85 }

56

65                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
66                Text("Hit all three targets today to extend the streak by one day.")
67                    .font(AGFont.body(12)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
68                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
69            }
70        }
71        .agCard()
72    }

75
76    private var waterCard: some View {
77        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
78            HStack {
79                AGSectionHeader(title: "Water")
80                Spacer()
81                TextField("0", value: $habitsVM.profile.dailyWaterML, format: .number)
82                    .keyboardType(.numberPad)
83                    .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
84                    .frame(width: 70)
85                    .font(AGFont.mono(13, weight: .semibold))
86                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)
87                    .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 4)

92            }
93
94            Slider(value: $habitsVM.profile.dailyWaterML,
95                   in: 0...(max(4000, habitsVM.profile.waterMLTarget * 1.5)),
96                   step: 100).tint(AGColor.teal)
97
98            HStack(spacing: 8) {
99                ForEach([250, 500, 750, 1000], id: \.self) { amount in

102                                                            habitsVM.profile.dailyWaterML + Double(amount))

108                            .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8).stroke(AGColor.teal.opacity(0.35), lineWidth: 1))
109                            .foregroundColor(AGColor.teal)
110                    }
111                    .buttonStyle(.plain)

113            }
114
115            targetSlider(title: "Daily target",

117                         range: 500...5000, step: 100,

144                .tint(AGColor.magenta)

147                         range: 4...12, step: 0.25,

156    private var customHabitCard: some View {
157        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
158            HStack {
159                AGSectionHeader(title: "Custom habit")
160                Spacer()
161                Toggle("", isOn: $habitsVM.profile.customHabitCompletedToday)
162                    .labelsHidden().tint(AGColor.amber)

164            TextField("Habit name (e.g. Meditation, Journaling)",
165                      text: $habitsVM.profile.customHabitName)
166                .font(AGFont.body(14))

177    private var reminderCard: some View {
178        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
179            Toggle(isOn: Binding(
180                get: { habitsVM.profile.remindersEnabled },
181                set: { newValue in
182                    habitsVM.profile.remindersEnabled = newValue
183                    habitsVM.toggleReminders(enabled: newValue)
184                }
185            )) {
186                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
187                    Text("Daily reminder").font(AGFont.headline(15))
188                        .foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)
189                    Text("Notification to log water, sleep and your habit.")
190                        .font(AGFont.body(12)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
191                }
192            }
193            .tint(AGColor.amber)
194
195            if habitsVM.profile.remindersEnabled {
196                DatePicker("Time",
197                           selection: $reminderTime,
198                           displayedComponents: .hourAndMinute)
199                    .datePickerStyle(.compact)
200                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)
201                    .onChange(of: reminderTime) { _, new in
202                        let comps = Calendar.current.dateComponents([.hour, .minute], from: new)
203                        habitsVM.profile.reminderHour = comps.hour ?? 20
204                        habitsVM.profile.reminderMinute = comps.minute ?? 0
205                        habitsVM.saveHabits()
206                        habitsVM.scheduleDailyReminder()
207                    }
208            }
209        }
210        .agCard()
211    }
212
213
214
215    private func targetSlider(title: String,
216                              value: Binding<Double>,
217                              range: ClosedRange<Double>,
218                              step: Double,
219                              format: @escaping (Double) -> String,
220                              tint: Color) -> some View {
221        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
222            HStack {
223                Text(title.uppercased()).kerning(1.2).font(AGFont.hud(10))
224                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
225                Spacer()
226                TextField("0", value: value, format: .number.precision(.fractionLength(step < 1 ? 1 : 0)))
227                    .keyboardType(step < 1 ? .decimalPad : .numberPad)
228                    .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
229                    .frame(width: 60)
230                    .font(AGFont.mono(11, weight: .semibold))
231                    .foregroundColor(tint)
232                    .padding(.horizontal, 6).padding(.vertical, 3)
233                    .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6).fill(AGColor.panelHi))
234                    .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6).stroke(tint.opacity(0.35), lineWidth: 1))
235                    .onChange(of: value.wrappedValue) { _, newVal in
236
237                        if newVal < range.lowerBound { value.wrappedValue = range.lowerBound }
238                        if newVal > range.upperBound { value.wrappedValue = range.upperBound }
239                    }
240            }
241            Slider(value: value, in: range, step: step).tint(tint)
242        }
243        .padding(.top, 4)
244    }
245
246
247
248    private var saveButton: some View {
249        AGPushButton(title: "Save habits", icon: "checkmark",
250                     fill: AGColor.amber, textColor: .black,
251                     isLoading: habitsVM.isLoading) {
252            let wasStreak = habitsVM.profile.streakDays
253            habitsVM.saveHabits()
254            authVM.userDidInteract()
255            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.3) {
256                if habitsVM.profile.streakDays > wasStreak {
257                    AGToastCenter.shared.show("Streak extended to \(habitsVM.profile.streakDays) days.",
258                                              kind: .success, celebrate: true)
259                } else if habitsVM.errorMessage == nil {
260                    AGToastCenter.shared.show("Habits saved.", kind: .success)
261                } else if let msg = habitsVM.errorMessage {
262                    AGToastCenter.shared.show(msg, kind: .error)
263                }
264            }
265        }
266    }
267}

6import SwiftUI

8struct LeaderboardView: View {
9    @EnvironmentObject var authVM: AuthViewModel
10    @StateObject private var leaderboardVM = LeaderboardViewModel()
11
12    var body: some View {
13        ScrollView {
14            VStack(spacing: 14) {
15                header
16                if let error = leaderboardVM.errorMessage {
17                    hintCard("Leaderboard could not load: " + error)
18                }
19                if let hint = leaderboardVM.rulesHint {
20                    hintCard(hint)
21                }
22                if leaderboardVM.users.isEmpty {
23                    emptyCard
24                } else {
25                    podiumCard
26                    fullListCard
27                }
28                scoringCard
29            }
30            .padding(16)
31            .padding(.bottom, 40)
32        }
33        .background(AGColor.canvas.ignoresSafeArea())
34        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
35        .toolbar {
36            ToolbarItem(placement: .principal) {
37                Text("Leaderboard").font(AGFont.headline(17))
38            }
39        }
40        .onAppear {
41            leaderboardVM.loadLeaderboard()
42            authVM.userDidInteract()
43        }
44    }
45
46    private var header: some View {
47        HStack(spacing: 12) {
48            ZStack {
49                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 18, style: .continuous)
50                    .fill(LinearGradient(colors: [AGColor.sunshine, AGColor.peach],
51                                         startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing))
52                    .frame(width: 56, height: 56)
53                Image(systemName: "trophy.fill").foregroundColor(.white)
54                    .font(.system(size: 24, weight: .bold))
55            }
56            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
57                Text("Global XP ranking").font(AGFont.title(20))
58                Text("Only users who opted in appear here.")
59                    .font(AGFont.caption(12)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
60            }
61            Spacer()
62        }
63        .agCard()
64    }
65
66    private func hintCard(_ hint: String) -> some View {
67        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 10) {
68            Image(systemName: "info.circle.fill").foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
69            Text(hint).font(AGFont.body(12)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
70                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
71            Spacer(minLength: 0)
72        }
73        .padding(12)
74        .background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).fill(AGColor.amber.opacity(0.08)))
75        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(AGColor.amber.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: 1))
76    }
77
78    private var emptyCard: some View {
79        VStack(spacing: 12) {
80            Image(systemName: "person.3.fill").font(.system(size: 30))
81                .foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
82            Text("No opt-ins yet").font(AGFont.headline(15))
83            Text("Toggle 'Share on leaderboard' in Profile to appear here.")
84                .font(AGFont.caption(12)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
85                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
86        }
87        .padding(30)
88        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
89        .agCard()
90    }
91
92    private var podiumCard: some View {
93        let top = Array(leaderboardVM.users.prefix(3))
94        return HStack(alignment: .bottom, spacing: 12) {
95            if top.count >= 2 {
96                podiumTile(rank: 2, user: top[1], height: 92, tint: AGColor.sky)
97            } else { Spacer().frame(maxWidth: .infinity) }
98            if top.count >= 1 {
99                podiumTile(rank: 1, user: top[0], height: 116, tint: AGColor.sunshine)
100            } else { Spacer().frame(maxWidth: .infinity) }
101            if top.count >= 3 {
102                podiumTile(rank: 3, user: top[2], height: 76, tint: AGColor.peach)
103            } else { Spacer().frame(maxWidth: .infinity) }
104        }
105        .padding(.vertical, 10)
106        .agCard()
107    }
108
109    private func podiumTile(rank: Int, user: LeaderboardUser, height: CGFloat, tint: Color) -> some View {
110        VStack(spacing: 6) {
111            ZStack {
112                Circle().fill(tint.opacity(0.25)).frame(width: 46, height: 46)
113                Text(String(user.name.prefix(1)).uppercased())
114                    .font(AGFont.title(20)).foregroundColor(tint)
115            }
116            Text(user.name.isEmpty ? "Anon" : user.name)
117                .font(AGFont.headline(12)).lineLimit(1)
118            Text("\(user.xp) XP").font(AGFont.caption(11)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
119            ZStack(alignment: .top) {
120                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12).fill(tint.opacity(0.25))
121                    .frame(height: height)
122                Text("\(rank)")
123                    .font(AGFont.number(28))
124                    .foregroundColor(tint)
125                    .padding(.top, 6)
126            }
127        }
128        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
129    }
130
131    private var fullListCard: some View {
132        VStack(spacing: 8) {
133            ForEach(Array(leaderboardVM.users.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, user in
134                HStack(spacing: 12) {
135                    Text("\(index + 1)")
136                        .font(AGFont.number(16))
137                        .frame(width: 30, height: 30)
138                        .background(Circle().fill(index < 3 ? AGColor.sunshine.opacity(0.25) : AGColor.canvas))
139                        .overlay(Circle().stroke(AGColor.stroke, lineWidth: 1))
140                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
141                        Text(user.name.isEmpty ? "Unnamed" : user.name)
142                            .font(AGFont.headline(14))
143                        Text("Level \(user.level) · \(user.xp) XP · \(GameEngine.xpForNextLevel(from: user.xp)) to next")
144                            .font(AGFont.caption(11)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
145                        if !user.badges.isEmpty {
146                            ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
147                                HStack(spacing: 6) {
148                                    ForEach(user.badges) { badge in
149                                        Text(badge.title)
150                                            .font(AGFont.caption(10).weight(.semibold))
151                                            .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 3)
152                                            .background(Capsule().fill(AGColor.coral.opacity(0.15)))
153                                            .foregroundColor(AGColor.coral)
154                                    }
155                                }
156                            }
157                        }
158                    }
159                    Spacer()
160                }
161                .padding(.vertical, 6)
162                if index < leaderboardVM.users.count - 1 {
163                    Divider().background(AGColor.stroke)
164                }
165            }
166        }
167        .agCard()
168    }
169
170    private var scoringCard: some View {
171        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
172            AGSectionHeader(title: "How XP works")
173            Text("Workouts award a base 50 XP plus bonuses: strength scales with volume, cardio with duration/distance/incline, mobility with time. Levels roll over every 500 XP. Habit streaks add 20 + 5 × streak days once all three habits are logged.")
174                .font(AGFont.body(13))
175                .foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
176        }
177        .agCard()
178    }
179}

6import SwiftUI
7
8struct HomeView: View {
9    @EnvironmentObject var authVM: AuthViewModel
10    @StateObject private var profileVM = ProfileViewModel()
11    @StateObject private var habitsVM  = HabitsViewModel()
12    @StateObject private var mealVM    = MealViewModel()
13    @StateObject private var workoutVM = WorkoutViewModel()
14
15
16    private var xp: Int { profileVM.profile.xp }
17    private var level: Int { GameEngine.level(for: xp) }
18    private var xpForLevel: Int { max(1, level * 500 - (level - 1) * 500) }
19    private var progressToNext: Double {
20        let base = (level - 1) * 500
21        let toNext = level * 500
22        let span = max(1, toNext - base)
23        return Double(xp - base) / Double(span)
24    }
25
26    private var todaysMeals: [MealEntry] {
27        let start = Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: Date())
28        return mealVM.meals.filter { Calendar.current.isDate($0.date, inSameDayAs: start) }
29    }
30    private var todaysCalories: Int { Int(todaysMeals.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.calories }) }
31    private var todaysProtein: Int { Int(todaysMeals.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.protein }) }
32    private var calorieTarget: Int {
33        profileVM.profile.calorieTarget > 0 ? profileVM.profile.calorieTarget : 2500
34    }
35
36    private var greeting: String {
37        let h = Calendar.current.component(.hour, from: Date())
38        switch h {
39        case 5..<12: return "Rise, replicant"
40        case 12..<17: return "Standby active"
41        case 17..<22: return "Nightshift approach"
42        default: return "3AM run detected"
43        }
44    }
45
46    var body: some View {
47        ScrollView {
48            VStack(spacing: 14) {
49                hudHeader
50                targetsHUD
51                heroLevelCard
52                quickTiles
53                mealsPreviewCard
54                lastWorkoutCard
55                habitsMiniCard
56            }
57            .padding(16)
58            .padding(.bottom, 60)
59        }
60        .background(AGColor.canvas.ignoresSafeArea())
61        .overlay(AGGrid().opacity(0.35).ignoresSafeArea().allowsHitTesting(false))
62        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
63        .toolbar {
64            ToolbarItem(placement: .principal) {
65                Text("AETHERGAIN").kerning(3).font(AGFont.hud(13))
66                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
67            }
68            ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarLeading) {
69                NavigationLink { LeaderboardView() } label: {
70                    Image(systemName: "trophy.fill").foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
71                }
72            }
73            ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) {
74                NavigationLink { ProfileView() } label: {
75                    Image(systemName: "person.crop.circle.fill").foregroundColor(AGColor.teal)
76                }
77            }
78        }
79        .onAppear { authVM.userDidInteract() }
80    }
81
82
83
84    private var hudHeader: some View {
85        HStack(alignment: .top) {
86            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
87                Text(greeting.uppercased()).kerning(1.8).font(AGFont.hud(10))
88                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
89                Text(profileVM.profile.name.isEmpty ? "Operator" : profileVM.profile.name)
90                    .font(AGFont.display(28)).foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)
91            }
92            Spacer()
93            AGStreakBadge(days: habitsVM.profile.streakDays)
94        }
95    }
96
97
98
99    private var targetsHUD: some View {
100        let remaining = calorieTarget - todaysCalories
101        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
102            AGSectionHeader(title: "Calories Remaining",
103                            subtitle: "Goal − Food + Exercise")
104            HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: 6) {
105                col("\(calorieTarget)", "GOAL")
106                sign("−")
107                col("\(todaysCalories)", "FOOD", tint: AGColor.amber)
108                sign("+")
109                col("0", "EXERCISE")
110                sign("=")
111                col("\(remaining)", "REMAIN",
112                    tint: remaining >= 0 ? AGColor.teal : AGColor.danger)
113            }
114            ProgressView(value: min(1, Double(todaysCalories) / Double(max(1, calorieTarget))))
115                .tint(AGColor.amber)
116            HStack(spacing: 8) {
117                AGHudChip(text: "P \(todaysProtein)/\(profileVM.profile.proteinTargetG)g", tint: AGColor.teal)
118                AGHudChip(text: "TDEE \(profileVM.profile.tdee) kcal", tint: AGColor.magenta)
119                AGHudChip(text: profileVM.profile.fitnessGoal.rawValue.uppercased(), tint: AGColor.amber)
120            }
121        }
122        .agCard()

124    private func col(_ value: String, _ label: String, tint: Color = AGColor.ink) -> some View {
125        VStack(spacing: 2) {
126            Text(value).font(AGFont.number(18)).foregroundColor(tint).lineLimit(1)
127                .minimumScaleFactor(0.5)

142            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {

144                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)

169    private func tile(icon: String, label: String, tint: Color) -> some View {

9import SwiftUI

12struct MealLogView: View {
13    @EnvironmentObject var authVM: AuthViewModel
14    @StateObject private var mealVM = MealViewModel()
15    @StateObject private var profileVM = ProfileViewModel()
16
17    @State private var selectedPhoto: PhotosPickerItem?
18    @State private var previewImage: UIImage?
19    @State private var showLogSheet = false
20    @State private var focusedMealType: MealType = .breakfast
21
22
23    @State private var selectedDate: Date = Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: Date())
24
25    private let unitOptions = ["g", "kg", "ml", "cup", "tbsp", "tsp", "oz", "piece", "serving", "small", "medium", "large"]
26
27
28
29    private var mealsForSelectedDay: [MealEntry] {
30        mealVM.meals.filter { Calendar.current.isDate($0.date, inSameDayAs: selectedDate) }
31    }
32    private func meals(for type: MealType) -> [MealEntry] {
33        mealsForSelectedDay.filter { $0.mealType == type }
34    }
35    private var totalCalories: Int { Int(mealsForSelectedDay.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.calories }) }
36    private var totalProtein: Int  { Int(mealsForSelectedDay.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.protein }) }
37    private var totalCarbs: Int    { Int(mealsForSelectedDay.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.carbs }) }
38    private var totalFat: Int      { Int(mealsForSelectedDay.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.fat }) }
39
40    private var calorieTarget: Int {
41        profileVM.profile.calorieTarget > 0 ? profileVM.profile.calorieTarget : 2500
42    }
43
44    private var isToday: Bool { Calendar.current.isDateInToday(selectedDate) }
45
46
47
48    private var dateForNewMeal: Date {
49        if isToday { return Date() }
50
51        let cal = Calendar.current
52        let now = cal.dateComponents([.hour, .minute, .second], from: Date())
53        return cal.date(bySettingHour: now.hour ?? 12,
54                        minute: now.minute ?? 0,
55                        second: now.second ?? 0,
56                        of: selectedDate) ?? selectedDate
57    }
58    private var isTomorrowBlocked: Bool {
59
60        Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: selectedDate) >= Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: Date())
61    }
62
63    var body: some View {
64        ScrollView {
65            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
66                dayPickerBar
67                caloriesRemainingCard
68                macrosDailyCard
69                ForEach(MealType.allCases) { type in
70                    mealSection(type: type)
71                }
72            }
73            .padding(16)
74            .padding(.bottom, 40)
75        }
76        .background(AGColor.canvas.ignoresSafeArea())
77        .overlay(AGGrid().opacity(0.35).ignoresSafeArea().allowsHitTesting(false))
78        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
79        .toolbar {
80            ToolbarItem(placement: .principal) {
81                Text("DIARY").kerning(2).font(AGFont.hud(12))
82                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
83            }
84        }
85        .sheet(isPresented: $showLogSheet) { logSheet.agToastLayer() }
86        .onAppear { authVM.userDidInteract() }
87    }
88
89
90
91    private var caloriesRemainingCard: some View {
92        let remaining = calorieTarget - totalCalories
93
94        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
95            AGSectionHeader(title: "Calories Remaining", subtitle: "Goal − Food + Exercise")
96            HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: 6) {
97                formulaColumn(value: "\(calorieTarget)", label: "GOAL")
98                sign("−")
99                formulaColumn(value: "\(totalCalories)", label: "FOOD")
100                sign("+")
101                formulaColumn(value: "0", label: "EXERCISE")
102                sign("=")
103                formulaColumn(value: "\(remaining)",
104                              label: "REMAINING",
105                              tint: remaining >= 0 ? AGColor.teal : AGColor.danger)
106            }
107            ProgressView(value: min(1, max(0, Double(totalCalories) / Double(max(1, calorieTarget)))))
108                .tint(AGColor.amber)
109        }
110        .agCard()
111    }
112
113    private func formulaColumn(value: String, label: String, tint: Color = AGColor.ink) -> some View {
114        VStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 2) {
115            Text(value).font(AGFont.number(20)).foregroundColor(tint).lineLimit(1)
116                .minimumScaleFactor(0.5)
117            Text(label).font(AGFont.hud(9)).kerning(1)
118                .foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
119        }
120        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
121    }
122    private func sign(_ s: String) -> some View {
123        Text(s).font(AGFont.mono(16, weight: .semibold)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
124    }
125
126
127
128    private var macrosDailyCard: some View {
129        HStack(spacing: 14) {
130            AGProgressRing(progress: ratio(totalCalories, profileVM.profile.calorieTarget),
131                           color: AGColor.amber, size: 88,
132                           label: "\(totalCalories)", sublabel: "KCAL")
133            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
134                macroLine(label: "Protein", value: totalProtein,
135                          target: profileVM.profile.proteinTargetG, tint: AGColor.teal)
136                macroLine(label: "Carbs", value: totalCarbs,
137                          target: profileVM.profile.carbsTargetG, tint: AGColor.amberHi)
138                macroLine(label: "Fat",   value: totalFat,
139                          target: profileVM.profile.fatTargetG, tint: AGColor.magenta)
140            }
141        }
142        .agCard()
143    }
144    private func macroLine(label: String, value: Int, target: Int, tint: Color) -> some View {
145        let t = max(1, target)
146        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
147            HStack {
148                Text(label.uppercased()).kerning(1.2).font(AGFont.hud(10))
149                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
150                Spacer()
151                Text("\(value) / \(target) g").font(AGFont.mono(11))
152                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)
153            }
154            ProgressView(value: min(1, Double(value) / Double(t))).tint(tint)
155        }
156    }
157    private func ratio(_ value: Int, _ target: Int) -> Double {
158        guard target > 0 else { return 0 }
159        return min(1, Double(value) / Double(target))
160    }

164    private func mealSection(type: MealType) -> some View {
165        let items = meals(for: type)
166        let kcal = Int(items.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.calories })
167        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
168            HStack {
169                Image(systemName: type.icon).foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
170                Text(type.rawValue.uppercased()).kerning(1.6).font(AGFont.hud(11))
171                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
172                Spacer()
173                Text("\(kcal) KCAL").font(AGFont.mono(11))
174                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
175            }
176            if items.isEmpty {
177                Button {
178                    focusedMealType = type
179                    mealVM.currentMeal.mealType = type
180                    mealVM.currentMeal.date = dateForNewMeal
181                    showLogSheet = true
182                    AGHaptics.tap()
183                } label: {
184                    HStack(spacing: 6) {
185                        Image(systemName: "plus.circle")
186                        Text("Add food").font(AGFont.body(13))
187                        Spacer()
188                    }
189                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.teal)
190                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
191                }
192                .buttonStyle(.plain)
193            } else {
194                ForEach(items) { entry in
195                    AGSwipeToDelete(onDelete: {
196                        mealVM.deleteMeal(entry)
197                        AGToastCenter.shared.show("Removed \(entry.foodName)", kind: .info)
198                    }) {
199                        mealRow(entry)
200                    }
201                    Divider().background(AGColor.stroke)
202                }
203                Button {
204                    focusedMealType = type
205                    mealVM.currentMeal.mealType = type
206                    mealVM.currentMeal.date = dateForNewMeal
207                    showLogSheet = true
208                } label: {
209                    HStack {
210                        Image(systemName: "plus")
211                        Text("Add another").font(AGFont.body(12))
212                        Spacer()
213                    }
214                    .foregroundColor(AGColor.teal)
215                }
216                .buttonStyle(.plain)
217            }
218        }
219        .agCard()
220    }

224    private func mealRow(_ entry: MealEntry) -> some View {
225        HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 10) {

236                            .foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)

242                    Spacer()

253            Button(role: .destructive) {

615    private var saveButton: some View {
616        let editing = mealVM.editingMealID != nil
617        return AGPushButton(
618            title: editing
619                ? "Update \(mealVM.currentMeal.mealType.rawValue.uppercased())"
620                : "Log to \(mealVM.currentMeal.mealType.rawValue.uppercased())",
621            icon: "checkmark",
622            fill: AGColor.amber,
623            textColor: .black,
624            isEnabled: !mealVM.currentMeal.foodName.isEmpty && mealVM.currentMeal.calories > 0,
625            isLoading: mealVM.isLoading
626        ) {
627            let foodName = mealVM.currentMeal.foodName
628            let mealType = mealVM.currentMeal.mealType
629            mealVM.saveMeal()
630            authVM.userDidInteract()
631            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) {
632                if mealVM.errorMessage == nil {
633                    AGToastCenter.shared.show(
634                        editing ? "Updated \(foodName)" : "Logged \(foodName) → \(mealType.rawValue)",
635                        kind: .success
636                    )
637                    previewImage = nil
638                    selectedPhoto = nil
639                    showLogSheet = false
640                } else if let msg = mealVM.errorMessage {
641                    AGToastCenter.shared.show(msg, kind: .error)
642                }
643            }
644        }
645    }
646
647
648
649    private func handlePhotoChange(_ newItem: PhotosPickerItem?) {
650        Task {
651            guard let newItem else { return }
652            do {
653                if let data = try await newItem.loadTransferable(type: Data.self),
654                   let uiImage = UIImage(data: data) {
655                    await MainActor.run {
656                        self.previewImage = uiImage
657                    }
658                    mealVM.analyzeMealPhoto(uiImage)
659                } else {
660                    await MainActor.run {
661                        mealVM.errorMessage = "Couldn't read that image — try another."
662                    }
663                }
664            } catch {
665                await MainActor.run {
666                    mealVM.errorMessage = "Photo load failed: \(error.localizedDescription)"
667                }
668            }
669        }
670    }
671}

6import SwiftUI
7
8struct PrivacyNoticeView: View {
9    @AppStorage("ag.privacy.accepted") private var accepted: Bool = false
10    @AppStorage("ag.privacy.shareLeaderboard") var optInLeaderboard: Bool = false
11    var onDone: () -> Void
12
13    var body: some View {
14        AGScreen {
15            ScrollView {
16                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
17                    header
18                    rightsCard(icon: "lock.shield.fill", tint: AGColor.teal,
19                               title: "Encrypted",
20                               body: "Every byte is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest on Google Cloud Firestore.")
21                    rightsCard(icon: "person.crop.circle.badge.checkmark", tint: AGColor.amber,
22                               title: "You control what's shared",
23                               body: "Profile, workouts, meals, and habits stay private by default. Nothing appears on the leaderboard unless you opt in below.")
24                    rightsCard(icon: "trash.circle.fill", tint: AGColor.magenta,
25                               title: "Right to delete",
26                               body: "Edit or delete any entry from the app. You may also request full account erasure.")
27                    rightsCard(icon: "cloud.fill", tint: AGColor.amberHi,
28                               title: "What we store",
29                               body: "Email (login), profile info you enter, workout/meal/habit logs, XP and streaks. No location, contacts, or health data unless you connect it explicitly.")
30
31                    Toggle(isOn: $optInLeaderboard) {
32                        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
33                            Text("Show me on the leaderboard")
34                                .font(AGFont.headline(14)).foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)
35                            Text("Display name, XP, level, and badges become visible to other users. Toggle any time in Profile.")
36                                .font(AGFont.body(11)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
37                        }
38                    }
39                    .tint(AGColor.amber)
40                    .agCard()
41
42                    AGPushButton(title: "I agree — continue", icon: "checkmark",
43                                 fill: AGColor.amber, textColor: .black) {
44                        accepted = true
45                        onDone()
46                    }
47                    .padding(.top, 4)
48
49                    Text("You are agreeing to the practices above. Revisit any time from Profile → Privacy.")
50                        .font(AGFont.body(11)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
51                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
52                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
53                        .padding(.bottom, 30)
54                }
55                .padding(16)
56            }
57        }
58    }
59
60    private var header: some View {
61        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
62            Text("WELCOME").kerning(3).font(AGFont.hud(11))
63                .foregroundColor(AGColor.amber)
64            Text("AetherGain").font(AGFont.display(32)).foregroundColor(AGColor.ink)
65            Text("Before you jack in, a quick word on your data and your rights.")
66                .font(AGFont.body(13)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
67        }
68    }
69
70    private func rightsCard(icon: String, tint: Color, title: String, body: String) -> some View {
71        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 12) {
72            ZStack {
73                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous)
74                    .fill(tint.opacity(0.15))
75                    .frame(width: 44, height: 44)
76                    .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(tint.opacity(0.4), lineWidth: 1))
77                Image(systemName: icon).font(.system(size: 18, weight: .bold))
78                    .foregroundColor(tint)
79            }
80            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
81                Text(title.uppercased()).kerning(1.4).font(AGFont.hud(11))
82                    .foregroundColor(tint)
83                Text(body).font(AGFont.body(12)).foregroundColor(AGColor.inkMuted)
84                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
85            }
86            Spacer(minLength: 0)
87        }
88        .agCard()
89    }
90}

12struct TargetsOnboardingView: View {

216    private func statTile(_ label: String, _ value: String, _ unit: String, tint: Color) -> some View {

234                AGGhostButton(title: "Back", icon: "chevron.left", accent: AGColor.teal) {
235                    withAnimation { stepIndex -= 1 }
236                }
237            }
238            Spacer()
239            AGPushButton(
240                title: stepIndex == stepCount - 1 ? "Save targets" : "Next",
241                icon: stepIndex == stepCount - 1 ? "checkmark" : "chevron.right",
242                fill: AGColor.amber, textColor: .black
243            ) {
244                if stepIndex == stepCount - 1 {
245                    finish()
246                } else {
247                    withAnimation { stepIndex += 1 }
248                }
249            }
250            .frame(width: 200)
251        }

266        onDone()

275private struct HUDTextFieldStyle: TextFieldStyle {
276    func _body(configuration: TextField<Self._Label>) -> some View {
277        configuration

85    private func uploadPfp(_ item: PhotosPickerItem?) {
86        guard let item else { return }
87        Task {
88            isUploadingPfp = true
89            defer { isUploadingPfp = false }
90            do {
91                guard let data = try await item.loadTransferable(type: Data.self),
92                      let uiImage = UIImage(data: data) else {
93                    AGToastCenter.shared.show("Couldn't read that image.", kind: .error)
94                    return
95                }
96                let url = try await ProfileImageService.upload(image: uiImage)
97                await MainActor.run {
98                    profileVM.profile.profileImageURL = url.absoluteString
99                    profileVM.saveProfile()
100                    AGToastCenter.shared.show("Avatar updated.", kind: .success)
101                }
102            } catch {
103                await MainActor.run {
104                    AGToastCenter.shared.show("Upload failed: \(error.localizedDescription)", kind: .error)
105                }
106            }
107        }
108    }

252private struct HeatmapGrid: View {
253    let cells: [ProgressAnalytics.HeatmapCell]
254    let columns: Int
255    let rows: Int
256
257    var body: some View {
258        GeometryReader { geo in
259            let spacing: CGFloat = 3
260            let w = (geo.size.width - CGFloat(columns - 1) * spacing) / CGFloat(columns)
261            let h = (geo.size.height - CGFloat(rows - 1) * spacing) / CGFloat(rows)
262
263
264            HStack(spacing: spacing) {
265                ForEach(0..<columns, id: \.self) { c in
266                    VStack(spacing: spacing) {
267                        ForEach(0..<rows, id: \.self) { r in
268                            let idx = c * rows + r
269                            if idx < cells.count {
270                                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 3)
271                                    .fill(color(for: cells[idx].intensity))
272                                    .frame(width: w, height: h)
273                            } else {
274                                Color.clear.frame(width: w, height: h)
275                            }
276                        }
277                    }
278                }
279            }
280        }
281    }
282
283    private func color(for intensity: Double) -> Color {
284        if intensity <= 0 { return AGColor.panelHi }
285        return AGColor.amber.opacity(0.15 + intensity * 0.85)
286    }
287}

23                    exerciseCard(index: index)

26                addExerciseCard
27                completeCard
28            }
29            .padding(16)
30            .padding(.bottom, 40)
31        }
32        .background(AGColor.canvas.ignoresSafeArea())
33        .sheet(isPresented: $showCustomExerciseSheet) { customExerciseSheet }
34        .onAppear {
35            if workoutVM.currentSession.exercises.isEmpty {
36                workoutVM.addExercise()
37            }
38            authVM.userDidInteract()
39        }
40    }

247                draft.exercises[index].type = $0
248            }
249        )
250    }
251
252    private func safeNotes(index: Int) -> Binding<String> {
253        Binding(
254            get: { draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) ? draft.exercises[index].notes : "" },
255            set: {
256                guard draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) else { return }
257                draft.exercises[index].notes = $0
258            }
259        )
260    }
261
262    private func safeInt(index: Int, keyPath: WritableKeyPath<Exercise, Int>) -> Binding<Int> {
263        Binding(
264            get: { draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) ? draft.exercises[index][keyPath: keyPath] : 0 },
265            set: {
266                guard draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) else { return }
267                draft.exercises[index][keyPath: keyPath] = $0
268            }
269        )
270    }
271
272    private func safeDouble(index: Int, keyPath: WritableKeyPath<Exercise, Double>) -> Binding<Double> {
273        Binding(
274            get: { draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) ? draft.exercises[index][keyPath: keyPath] : 0 },
275            set: {
276                guard draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) else { return }
277                draft.exercises[index][keyPath: keyPath] = $0
278            }
279        )
280    }
281
282    private func safeOptionalDouble(index: Int, keyPath: WritableKeyPath<Exercise, Double?>) -> Binding<Double> {
283        Binding(
284            get: { draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) ? (draft.exercises[index][keyPath: keyPath] ?? 0) : 0 },
285            set: {
286                guard draft.exercises.indices.contains(index) else { return }
287                draft.exercises[index][keyPath: keyPath] = $0
288            }
289        )
290    }
291
292    private func iconFor(_ c: ExerciseCategory) -> String {
293        switch c {
294        case .strength: return "dumbbell.fill"
295        case .cardio:   return "figure.run"
296        case .mobility: return "figure.mind.and.body"
297        }
298    }
299    private func colorFor(_ c: ExerciseCategory) -> Color {
300        switch c {
301        case .strength: return AGColor.amber
302        case .cardio:   return AGColor.teal
303        case .mobility: return AGColor.magenta
304        }
305    }
306
307
308
309    private func save() {
310        errorMessage = nil
311        isSaving = true
312        workoutVM.updateSession(draft) { error in
313            isSaving = false
314            if let err = error {
315                errorMessage = err.localizedDescription
316                AGToastCenter.shared.show(err.localizedDescription, kind: .error)
317            } else {
318                AGToastCenter.shared.show("Workout updated (delta \(xpDelta) XP).",
319                                          kind: .success)
320                dismiss()
321            }
322        }
323    }
324}

325    private func strengthVolume(_ session: WorkoutSession) -> Double {
326        session.exercises
327            .filter { $0.category == .strength }
328            .reduce(0) { $0 + Double($1.sets * $1.reps) * max($1.weightKG, 1) }
329    }
330
331    private func cardioMinutes(_ session: WorkoutSession) -> Double {
332        session.exercises
333            .filter { $0.category == .cardio }
334            .reduce(0) { $0 + ($1.durationMinutes ?? 0) }
335    }
336
337    private func exerciseSummary(_ exercise: Exercise) -> String {
338        switch exercise.category ?? .strength {
339        case .strength:
340            return String(format: "%@ · %dx%d @ %.1f kg",
341                          exercise.type, exercise.sets, exercise.reps, exercise.weightKG)
342        case .cardio:
343            let d = exercise.distanceKM ?? 0
344            let t = exercise.durationMinutes ?? 0
345            let i = exercise.inclinePercent ?? 0
346            return String(format: "%@ · %.1f km · %.0f min · %.0f%% incline",
347                          exercise.type, d, t, i)
348        case .mobility:
349            let t = exercise.durationMinutes ?? 0
350            return String(format: "%@ · %.0f min", exercise.type, t)
351        }
352    }
353}

MLTraining/check_dataset.py


1#!/usr/bin/env python3
2"""
3Checks the training set before train_model.swift runs.
4
5Layout
6------
7Training/<FoodName>/                 the class label
8Training/<FoodName>/<variation>/     optional, counted towards the same label
9
10Every image below Training/<FoodName>/ trains as the single label <FoodName>.
11The class name must match a `name` in FoodDatabase.swift exactly, otherwise the
12model emits a label that bestMatch() cannot resolve to any macros.
13"""
14
15import os
16import re
17import sys
18
19EXTENSIONS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".heic"}
20MIN_PER_CLASS = 25          # below this Create ML's validation split gets noisy
21MIN_PER_VARIATION = 5
22IMBALANCE_FACTOR = 3        # largest class vs smallest
23
24HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
25TRAINING = os.path.join(HERE, "Training")
26FOOD_DB = os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, "AetherGain", "Services", "FoodDatabase.swift")
27
28
29def database_names():
30    """Names defined in FoodDatabase.swift, or None if the file is missing."""
31    try:
32        with open(FOOD_DB, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
33            source = handle.read()
34    except OSError:
35        return None
36    return {m.lower() for m in re.findall(r'FoodMacros\(name:\s*"([^"]+)"', source)}
37
38
39def count_images(directory):
40    """(total, {variation: count}) for everything below `directory`."""
41    per_variation = {}
42    total = 0
43    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
44        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
45        images = [f for f in files
46                  if os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower() in EXTENSIONS
47                  and not f.startswith(".")]
48        if not images:
49            continue
50        relative = os.path.relpath(root, directory)
51        label = "(top level)" if relative == "." else relative
52        per_variation[label] = len(images)
53        total += len(images)
54    return total, per_variation
55
56
57def main():
58    if not os.path.isdir(TRAINING):
59        sys.exit("Training/ is missing.")
60
61    known = database_names()
62    classes = sorted(d for d in os.listdir(TRAINING)
63                     if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(TRAINING, d)) and not d.startswith("."))
64    if not classes:
65        sys.exit("No class folders under Training/.")
66
67    problems, notes, counts = [], [], {}
68    width = max(len(c) for c in classes)
69
70    for name in classes:
71        total, variations = count_images(os.path.join(TRAINING, name))
72        counts[name] = total
73
74        print(f"{name.ljust(width)}  {total:>4} images")
75        if len(variations) > 1 or "(top level)" not in variations:
76            for variation, n in sorted(variations.items()):
77                print(f"{' ' * width}    {variation}: {n}")
78                if n < MIN_PER_VARIATION:
79                    notes.append(f"{name}/{variation}: only {n} images — "
80                                 f"too few to teach the variation anything")
81
82        if total == 0:
83            problems.append(f"{name}: empty — Create ML fails on an empty class, "
84                            f"delete the folder or fill it")
85        elif total < MIN_PER_CLASS:
86            notes.append(f"{name}: {total} images, {MIN_PER_CLASS} recommended")
87
88        if known is not None and name.lower() not in known:
89            problems.append(f"{name}: no entry with this name in FoodDatabase.swift — "
90                            f"the model would emit a label nothing can resolve")
91
92    print("-" * (width + 14))
93    print(f"{'total'.ljust(width)}  {sum(counts.values()):>4} images in {len(classes)} classes")
94
95    populated = {k: v for k, v in counts.items() if v}
96    if len(populated) >= 2:
97        smallest, largest = min(populated.values()), max(populated.values())
98        if largest > smallest * IMBALANCE_FACTOR:
99            weakest = min(populated, key=populated.get)
100            notes.append(f"imbalance: largest class has {largest} images, "
101                         f"{weakest} has {smallest} — the model will favour the big ones")
102    if len(populated) < 2:
103        problems.append("fewer than two classes have images — nothing to train")
104
105    if problems:
106        print("\nFix first:")
107        for p in problems:
108            print("  -", p)
109    if notes:
110        print("\nWorth improving:")
111        for n in notes:
112            print("  -", n)
113
114    if problems:
115        sys.exit(1)
116    print("\nGood to go:  swift train_model.swift")
117
118
119if __name__ == "__main__":
120    main()

MLTraining/prepare_dataset.py


1#!/usr/bin/env python3
2"""
3prepare_dataset.py — fold an external image set into MLTraining/Training.
4
5It does NOT download anything. Point it at a folder you already have: a
6dataset you downloaded yourself under its own licence, or a folder of your
7own photos. It cleans that folder up and files the images under the class
8names this project uses.
9
10    python3 prepare_dataset.py ~/Downloads/indian-food --make-map
11    # edit mapping.json, then
12    python3 prepare_dataset.py ~/Downloads/indian-food --map mapping.json
13
14Expected source layout — one subfolder per class, any names:
15
16    indian-food/
17      masala_dosa/  *.jpg
18      plain_rice/   *.jpg
19      ...
20
21What it does per image
22    - opens and verifies it (corrupt files are skipped, not copied)
23    - drops anything smaller than --min-size on the short side
24    - drops near-duplicates using a difference hash, within and across classes
25    - converts to RGB JPEG, longest side --max-size
26    - writes to Training/<FoodDatabase name>/<class>_ext_NNN.jpg
27
28It never overwrites a file that is already there, so your own photos are safe.
29
30Class names in `mapping.json` must match a `name` in FoodDatabase.swift, since
31that is what bestMatch() compares the model's label against.
32"""
33
34from __future__ import annotations
35
36import argparse
37import json
38import os
39import re
40import sys
41from collections import defaultdict
42
43try:
44    from PIL import Image
45except ImportError:
46    sys.exit("Pillow is missing.  pip3 install Pillow")
47
48EXTENSIONS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".bmp", ".heic"}
49HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
50DEFAULT_OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "Training")
51FOOD_DB = os.path.join(HERE, os.pardir, "AetherGain", "Services", "FoodDatabase.swift")
52
53
54# ---------------------------------------------------------------- FoodDatabase
55
56def database_names() -> list[str]:
57    """The `name` of every FoodMacros entry, in file order."""
58    try:
59        with open(FOOD_DB, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
60            source = handle.read()
61    except OSError:
62        return []
63    return re.findall(r'FoodMacros\(name:\s*"([^"]+)"', source)
64
65
66def normalise(text: str) -> str:
67    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text.lower()).strip()
68
69
70def guess_mapping(source_classes: list[str], known: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
71    """Best-effort source folder -> FoodDatabase name, for --make-map.
72
73    Only offers a guess when the normalised names share a whole word, so a
74    wrong guess is obvious rather than plausible. Everything else is left
75    empty for you to fill in or delete.
76    """
77    by_word: dict[str, str] = {}
78    for name in known:
79        for word in normalise(name).split():
80            by_word.setdefault(word, name)
81
82    mapping: dict[str, str] = {}
83    for folder in source_classes:
84        words = normalise(folder).split()
85        hit = ""
86        for word in words:
87            if word in by_word:
88                hit = by_word[word]
89                break
90        mapping[folder] = hit
91    return mapping
92
93
94# ---------------------------------------------------------------- image tools
95
96def dhash(image: Image.Image, size: int = 8) -> int:
97    """Difference hash: resize to (size+1, size), compare adjacent pixels.
98
99    Two images that differ only in compression, small crops or resizing land
100    on the same hash, which is what we want for de-duplicating a scraped set.
101    """
102    grey = image.convert("L").resize((size + 1, size), Image.LANCZOS)
103    pixels = grey.tobytes()
104    bits = 0
105    for row in range(size):
106        offset = row * (size + 1)
107        for col in range(size):
108            bits = (bits << 1) | int(pixels[offset + col] > pixels[offset + col + 1])
109    return bits
110
111
112def hamming(a: int, b: int) -> int:
113    return bin(a ^ b).count("1")
114
115
116# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main passes
117
118def collect(source_root: str) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
119    """{source class folder: [image paths]} for immediate subfolders."""
120    found: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
121    for entry in sorted(os.listdir(source_root)):
122        folder = os.path.join(source_root, entry)
123        if not os.path.isdir(folder) or entry.startswith("."):
124            continue
125        images = []
126        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(folder):
127            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
128            for name in sorted(files):
129                if os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower() in EXTENSIONS and not name.startswith("."):
130                    images.append(os.path.join(root, name))
131        if images:
132            found[entry] = images
133    return found
134
135
136def existing_hashes(out_root: str, max_side: int) -> tuple[set[int], list[int]]:
137    """Hashes of what is already in Training/, so we never re-add a photo."""
138    seen: list[int] = []
139    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(out_root):
140        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
141        for name in files:
142            if os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower() not in EXTENSIONS:
143                continue
144            try:
145                with Image.open(os.path.join(root, name)) as image:
146                    seen.append(dhash(image))
147            except Exception:
148                continue
149    return set(seen), seen
150
151
152def main() -> None:
153    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
154                                     formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
155    parser.add_argument("source", help="folder with one subfolder per class")
156    parser.add_argument("--map", dest="mapping", default=None,
157                        help="JSON of {source folder: FoodDatabase name}")
158    parser.add_argument("--make-map", action="store_true",
159                        help="write a starter mapping.json and stop")
160    parser.add_argument("--out", default=DEFAULT_OUT, help="Training/ directory")
161    parser.add_argument("--cap", type=int, default=200,
162                        help="maximum images to add per class (default 200)")
163    parser.add_argument("--min-size", type=int, default=200,
164                        help="skip images whose short side is under this (default 200)")
165    parser.add_argument("--max-size", type=int, default=512,
166                        help="longest side after resizing (default 512)")
167    parser.add_argument("--hash-distance", type=int, default=4,
168                        help="0 = byte-identical only, higher = more aggressive (default 4)")
169    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="report, write nothing")
170    args = parser.parse_args()
171
172    if not os.path.isdir(args.source):
173        sys.exit(f"{args.source} is not a folder.")
174
175    sources = collect(args.source)
176    if not sources:
177        sys.exit("No class subfolders with images under that path.")
178
179    known = database_names()
180
181    if args.make_map:
182        mapping = guess_mapping(list(sources), known)
183        path = os.path.join(HERE, "mapping.json")
184        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
185            json.dump(mapping, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
186        filled = sum(1 for v in mapping.values() if v)
187        print(f"Wrote {path}")
188        print(f"{len(mapping)} source classes, {filled} guessed, "
189              f"{len(mapping) - filled} left blank.")
190        print("Edit it: put a FoodDatabase name on the right, or leave it blank to skip")
191        print("that class. Names must match FoodDatabase.swift exactly.")
192        if known:
193            print(f"\nAvailable names ({len(known)}):")
194            print("  " + ", ".join(known))
195        return
196
197    if not args.mapping:
198        sys.exit("Need --map mapping.json (run --make-map first).")
199    with open(args.mapping, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
200        mapping = json.load(handle)
201
202    unknown = sorted({v for v in mapping.values() if v and known and v not in known})
203    if unknown:
204        print("These targets have no entry in FoodDatabase.swift:")
205        for name in unknown:
206            print("  -", name)
207        print("Add them to FoodDatabase.all or fix the spelling, then run again.\n")
208        sys.exit(1)
209
210    seen_hashes, hash_list = ([], []) if args.dry_run else existing_hashes(args.out, args.max_size)
211    hash_list = list(hash_list)
212
213    kept = defaultdict(int)
214    skipped = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
215
216    for source_class, images in sources.items():
217        target = mapping.get(source_class, "")
218        if not target:
219            skipped[source_class]["unmapped"] = len(images)
220            continue
221
222        destination = os.path.join(args.out, target)
223        if not args.dry_run:
224            os.makedirs(destination, exist_ok=True)
225
226        index = 0
227        for path in images:
228            if kept[target] >= args.cap:
229                skipped[source_class]["over cap"] += 1
230                continue
231            try:
232                with Image.open(path) as image:
233                    image.load()
234                    if min(image.size) < args.min_size:
235                        skipped[source_class]["too small"] += 1
236                        continue
237                    digest = dhash(image)
238                    if any(hamming(digest, other) <= args.hash_distance for other in hash_list):
239                        skipped[source_class]["duplicate"] += 1
240                        continue
241
242                    image = image.convert("RGB")
243                    longest = max(image.size)
244                    if longest > args.max_size:
245                        scale = args.max_size / longest
246                        image = image.resize((max(1, round(image.width * scale)),
247                                              max(1, round(image.height * scale))),
248                                             Image.LANCZOS)
249
250                    if not args.dry_run:
251                        while True:
252                            index += 1
253                            name = f"{target.lower().replace(' ', '_')}_ext_{index:03d}.jpg"
254                            candidate = os.path.join(destination, name)
255                            if not os.path.exists(candidate):
256                                break
257                        image.save(candidate, "JPEG", quality=90)
258
259                    hash_list.append(digest)
260                    kept[target] += 1
261            except Exception as error:
262                skipped[source_class][f"unreadable ({type(error).__name__})"] += 1
263
264    print("Added" + (" (dry run, nothing written)" if args.dry_run else ""))
265    width = max((len(k) for k in kept), default=10)
266    for name in sorted(kept):
267        print(f"  {name.ljust(width)}  {kept[name]:>4}")
268    print(f"  {'total'.ljust(width)}  {sum(kept.values()):>4}")
269
270    if skipped:
271        print("\nSkipped")
272        for source_class in sorted(skipped):
273            reasons = ", ".join(f"{n} {why}" for why, n in sorted(skipped[source_class].items()))
274            print(f"  {source_class}: {reasons}")
275
276    if known:
277        covered = {v for v in mapping.values() if v}
278        print(f"\nCoverage: {len(covered)} of {len(known)} FoodDatabase entries have a class.")
279
280    print("\nNext:  python3 check_dataset.py   then   swift train_model.swift")
281
282
283if __name__ == "__main__":
284    main()

1#!/usr/bin/env swift
2//
3//  train_model.swift
4//  AetherGain
5//
6//  Trains an image classifier from MLTraining/Training and writes
7//  FoodClassifier.mlmodel next to the MLTraining folder.
8//
9//  Run from inside MLTraining:
10//      swift train_model.swift
11//
12//  Folder layout
13//  -------------
14//  Training/<FoodName>/                      <- the class label
15//  Training/<FoodName>/<variation>/          <- optional, any depth
16//
17//  Every image found anywhere below Training/<FoodName>/ trains as the single
18//  label <FoodName>. Variation subfolders exist so you can keep "plain" and
19//  "masala" dosa apart while you are collecting, without splitting the class.
20//  The script copies everything into a flat staging directory before training,
21//  because Create ML's labeledDirectories reads one level only.
22//
23//  IMPORTANT: <FoodName> must match a `name` in FoodDatabase.swift exactly.
24//  The model emits the folder name as its label, and FoodDatabase.bestMatch
25//  compares that label against those names.
26//
27//  If a variation has materially different macros (masala dosa is not plain
28//  dosa), it needs its own FoodDatabase entry and its own top-level folder.
29//  Keep it as a subfolder only when the macros are the same.
30//
31
32import CreateML
33import Foundation
34
35let fm = FileManager.default
36let imageExtensions: Set<String> = ["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "heic"]
37
38let cwd = URL(fileURLWithPath: fm.currentDirectoryPath)
39let trainingDir = cwd.appendingPathComponent("Training")
40let outputURL = cwd.deletingLastPathComponent()
41    .appendingPathComponent("AetherGain")
42    .appendingPathComponent("AetherGainFoodModel.mlmodel")
43
44guard fm.fileExists(atPath: trainingDir.path) else {
45    print("ERROR: Training/ not found. Run this script from inside MLTraining.")
46    exit(1)
47}
48
49// MARK: - Flatten variation subfolders into one directory per class
50
51let stagingDir = fm.temporaryDirectory
52    .appendingPathComponent("AetherGainDataset-\(UUID().uuidString)")
53
54func imageURLs(under directory: URL) -> [URL] {
55    guard let walker = fm.enumerator(at: directory,
56                                     includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey],
57                                     options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]) else { return [] }
58    return walker.compactMap { $0 as? URL }
59        .filter { imageExtensions.contains($0.pathExtension.lowercased()) }
60}
61
62var classCounts: [String: Int] = [:]
63
64do {
65    try fm.createDirectory(at: stagingDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
66
67    let classDirs = try fm.contentsOfDirectory(at: trainingDir,
68                                               includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isDirectoryKey],
69                                               options: [.skipsHiddenFiles])
70        .filter { (try? $0.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isDirectoryKey]).isDirectory) == true }
71        .sorted { $0.lastPathComponent < $1.lastPathComponent }
72
73    for classDir in classDirs {
74        let label = classDir.lastPathComponent
75        let images = imageURLs(under: classDir)
76        guard !images.isEmpty else {
77            print("SKIPPED \(label): no images — an empty folder makes Create ML fail.")
78            continue
79        }
80
81        let destination = stagingDir.appendingPathComponent(label)
82        try fm.createDirectory(at: destination, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
83
84        for (index, image) in images.enumerated() {
85            // Keep the variation in the file name so a misfiled photo is easy
86            // to trace back after training.
87            let variation = image.deletingLastPathComponent().lastPathComponent
88            let suffix = (variation == label) ? "" : "_\(variation)"
89            let name = "\(label)\(suffix)_\(String(format: "%03d", index + 1)).\(image.pathExtension)"
90            try fm.copyItem(at: image, to: destination.appendingPathComponent(name))
91        }
92        classCounts[label] = images.count
93    }
94} catch {
95    print("ERROR while preparing the dataset: \(error)")
96    exit(1)
97}
98
99guard classCounts.count >= 2 else {
100    print("ERROR: need at least two classes with images, found \(classCounts.count).")
101    try? fm.removeItem(at: stagingDir)
102    exit(1)
103}
104
105print("Dataset")
106for (label, count) in classCounts.sorted(by: { $0.key < $1.key }) {
107    print("  \(label.padding(toLength: 14, withPad: " ", startingAt: 0)) \(count) images")
108}
109print("  total: \(classCounts.values.reduce(0, +)) images in \(classCounts.count) classes")
110print("")
111print("Output: \(outputURL.path)")
112print("Training, this takes a few minutes...")
113print("")
114
115// MARK: - Train
116
117do {
118    let data = MLImageClassifier.DataSource.labeledDirectories(at: stagingDir)
119    let classifier = try MLImageClassifier(trainingData: data)
120
121    let trainingAccuracy = (1.0 - classifier.trainingMetrics.classificationError) * 100
122    let validationAccuracy = (1.0 - classifier.validationMetrics.classificationError) * 100
123    print(String(format: "Training accuracy:   %.1f %%", trainingAccuracy))
124    if validationAccuracy.isNaN {
125        // With very few images per class the automatic split can leave the
126        // validation set empty, and Create ML reports NaN. Train on more
127        // photos before trusting the model.
128        print("Validation accuracy: not measured — too few images for a split.")
129    } else {
130        print(String(format: "Validation accuracy: %.1f %%", validationAccuracy))
131    }
132
133    let metadata = MLModelMetadata(
134        author: "Dhriti",
135        shortDescription: "AetherGain food classifier trained on the client's own meals.",
136        version: "1.0"
137    )
138    if fm.fileExists(atPath: outputURL.path) {
139        try fm.removeItem(at: outputURL)
140    }
141    try classifier.write(to: outputURL, metadata: metadata)
142
143    print("")
144    print("Done. AetherGainFoodModel.mlmodel is in the AetherGain/ source folder.")
145    print("That folder is a synchronized group, so Xcode picks the model up on")
146    print("the next build — nothing to drag, nothing to tick.")
147
148    if validationAccuracy.isNaN || validationAccuracy < 70 {
149        print("")
150        print("WARNING: below 70 % validation accuracy this model is not worth bundling.")
151        print("A confidently wrong model is worse than the Vision fallback.")
152        print("Add more photos per class, or drop the classes with the fewest.")
153    }
154} catch {
155    print("ERROR during training: \(error)")
156    try? fm.removeItem(at: stagingDir)
157    exit(1)
158}
159
160try? fm.removeItem(at: stagingDir)

1#!/usr/bin/env python3
2"""
3AetherGain weekly analysis (Criterion 8).
4
5Reads a CSV exported from the app (Progress tab -> Export CSV) and produces:
6  1. A CSV summary of weekly totals and averages.
7  2. A PDF report with weekly trend charts (XP, workouts, macros, water, sleep).
8
9Usage:
10    python3 generate_report.py aethergain_weekly.csv --out report.pdf
11
12CSV schema (11 columns):
13    date,day,xp,workouts,calories,protein_g,carbs_g,fat_g,water_ml,sleep_hours,habit_done
14
15Dependencies:
16    pip install pandas matplotlib
17"""
18
19import argparse
20import os
21import sys
22from datetime import datetime
23
24import pandas as pd
25import matplotlib
26matplotlib.use("Agg")
27import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
28from matplotlib.backends.backend_pdf import PdfPages
29
30
31PALETTE = {
32    "coral":    "#FF8C7A",
33    "lavender": "#B7AEFA",
34    "mint":     "#8CDAB5",
35    "sky":      "#8CCCF9",
36    "peach":    "#FFC6A5",
37    "sun":      "#FFD966",
38}
39
40
41def load(csv_path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
42    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
43    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
44    df = df.sort_values("date").reset_index(drop=True)
45    return df
46
47
48def summarise(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
49    logged_meals = df[df["calories"] > 0]
50    logged_sleep = df[df["sleep_hours"] > 0]
51    return {
52        "range_start": df["date"].min().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
53        "range_end":   df["date"].max().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
54        "total_xp":       int(df["xp"].sum()),
55        "total_workouts": int(df["workouts"].sum()),
56        "avg_calories":   round(logged_meals["calories"].mean(), 1) if not logged_meals.empty else 0.0,
57        "avg_protein":    round(logged_meals["protein_g"].mean(), 1) if not logged_meals.empty else 0.0,
58        "avg_carbs":      round(logged_meals["carbs_g"].mean(), 1) if not logged_meals.empty else 0.0,
59        "avg_fat":        round(logged_meals["fat_g"].mean(), 1) if not logged_meals.empty else 0.0,
60        "avg_water_ml":   round(df["water_ml"].mean(), 0),
61        "avg_sleep":      round(logged_sleep["sleep_hours"].mean(), 1) if not logged_sleep.empty else 0.0,
62        "habit_hit_days": int(df["habit_done"].sum()),
63    }
64
65
66def write_summary_csv(summary: dict, out_path: str) -> None:
67    pd.DataFrame([summary]).to_csv(out_path, index=False)
68
69
70def build_pdf(df: pd.DataFrame, summary: dict, out_path: str) -> None:
71    with PdfPages(out_path) as pdf:
72        # --- Cover / summary page ---
73        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 11))
74        ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
75        ax.axis("off")
76        title = f"AetherGain Weekly Report\n{summary['range_start']} → {summary['range_end']}"
77        ax.text(0.5, 0.92, title, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=20, fontweight="bold")
78
79        stats_lines = [
80            f"Total XP earned:         {summary['total_xp']}",
81            f"Workouts completed:      {summary['total_workouts']}",
82            f"Days habits completed:   {summary['habit_hit_days']}",
83            "",
84            f"Avg calories / logged day:  {summary['avg_calories']:.0f} kcal",
85            f"Avg protein:                {summary['avg_protein']:.0f} g",
86            f"Avg carbs:                  {summary['avg_carbs']:.0f} g",
87            f"Avg fat:                    {summary['avg_fat']:.0f} g",
88            "",
89            f"Avg water (today snapshot): {summary['avg_water_ml']:.0f} ml",
90            f"Avg sleep / logged day:     {summary['avg_sleep']:.1f} h",
91        ]
92        ax.text(0.08, 0.78, "\n".join(stats_lines), va="top", fontsize=13,
93                family="monospace")
94        ax.text(0.5, 0.04,
95                f"Generated {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}",
96                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9, color="gray")
97        pdf.savefig(fig)
98        plt.close(fig)
99
100        # --- XP + workouts page ---
101        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(8.5, 11))
102        axes[0].bar(df["day"], df["xp"], color=PALETTE["lavender"])
103        axes[0].set_title("Daily XP")
104        axes[0].set_ylabel("XP")
105        axes[1].bar(df["day"], df["workouts"], color=PALETTE["mint"])
106        axes[1].set_title("Workouts per day")
107        axes[1].set_ylabel("Sessions")
108        for ax in axes:
109            ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
110            ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
111        fig.tight_layout()
112        pdf.savefig(fig)
113        plt.close(fig)
114
115        # --- Macros page ---
116        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 6))
117        ax.plot(df["day"], df["protein_g"], marker="o", color=PALETTE["lavender"], label="Protein (g)")
118        ax.plot(df["day"], df["carbs_g"],   marker="o", color=PALETTE["peach"],    label="Carbs (g)")
119        ax.plot(df["day"], df["fat_g"],     marker="o", color=PALETTE["sky"],      label="Fat (g)")
120        ax.set_title("Macros trend")
121        ax.set_ylabel("Grams")
122        ax.legend()
123        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
124        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
125        fig.tight_layout()
126        pdf.savefig(fig)
127        plt.close(fig)
128
129
130def main(argv=None) -> int:
131    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="AetherGain weekly analysis report")
132    parser.add_argument("csv", help="Path to CSV exported from the app")
133    parser.add_argument("--out", default="report.pdf", help="Output PDF path")
134    parser.add_argument("--summary", default="summary.csv",
135                        help="Output CSV summary path")
136    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
137
138    if not os.path.isfile(args.csv):
139        print(f"Input CSV not found: {args.csv}", file=sys.stderr)
140        return 1
141
142    df = load(args.csv)
143    if df.empty:
144        print("No rows in input CSV.", file=sys.stderr)
145        return 1
146
147    summary = summarise(df)
148    write_summary_csv(summary, args.summary)
149    build_pdf(df, summary, args.out)
150    print(f"Summary CSV: {args.summary}")
151    print(f"PDF report:  {args.out}")
152    return 0
153
154
155if __name__ == "__main__":
156    sys.exit(main())
